messages.subject: strange ggplot2 error message
parts:
Hi,

In producing facetted graphics, I sometimes get this message:

load(url("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/612902/%20Data%20for%20diet%20plot.Rda"))
a <- ggplot(thedataB, aes(x = Length_Class, y = value, fill = PreyNames)) + opts(title = "Cod Diet") +
labs(x = "Cod length (cm)", y = "Fullness Index")
theme_set(theme_bw())
b = a + geom_bar(stat = "identity") + facet_wrap(~ PreyNames, ncol=5)
c = b + opts(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = theme_text(hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5), axis.text.y = theme_text(hjust=0.5, vjust=0.5) )
c
Erreur dans get(x, envir = this, inherits = inh)(this, ...) :
tentative d'appliquer un objet qui n'est pas une fonction

something like "attempting to apply (use?) an object that is not a function

Sometimes, closing R and restarting it will allow me to run the same code without modification. Other times, I am unable to get the figure produced.

Puzzled Denis

messages.author: 36ec1331d4d5918f
messages.subject: Re: strange ggplot2 error message
parts:
A night sleep sometimes does wonders.

I checked my code before the ggplot call and I noticed that I stupidly
used "seq" as a variable name. Changing this variable to another name
solved my problem. I guess seq was the object that ggplot expected to
be a function but that was not a function, thanks to me.

Denis
